newsitem.title: UK: Dart UK buys 2nd Airbus for Channel Express.
newsitem.headline: Dart UK buys 2nd Airbus for Channel Express.

text.p: UK company Dart Group Plc has purchased a passenger A300B4-200 aircraft from Continental Airlines, Tony Carder, sales head of Dart cargo subsidiary Channel Express told Reuters.
While declining to disclose financial details, he said the plane, taken out of storage, was expected to arrive in the UK on Thursday.
It would then fly to Dresden for conversion into a freighter by Germany's Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG (DASA), he said.

"The aircraft will be delivered to Channel Express in full-freighter configuration in mid-November. Discussions have begun with potential charter customers but no contracts have yet been signed," said Carder.
Channel Express acquired its first A300B4 -- formerly in service with Eastern Airlines of the U.S. and Venezuela's VIASA -- from a U.S. financial institution late last year.
This was converted into a freighter by British Aerospace Plc at that company's Filton plant, near Bristol.

"That aircraft has just received its supplemental type certificate (STC) from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration and we are expecting similar aproval from Britain's Civil Aviation Authority by the beginning of next month," Carder said.

He added that from July to September, this first Channel Express Airbus freighter would be wet-leased to an unnamed European customer. Wet-leasing covers hire of crew and plane and usually also includes insurance and maintenance.
From September 4, he said, the aircraft would be wet-leased to British Airways to operate that carrier's planned new London Stansted-Tel Aviv cargo service.
"We also expect a third A300B4 in freighter configuration to join our fleet in either April or September next year," said Carder.
"We have yet to identify the particular (passenger) aircraft we want and are also undecided as to whether British Aerospace or DASA will get the contract to convert it into a freighter," he said.
"Conversion time would be about four months," he noted.
